# Site shell (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Owns the `SiteShell` content query (`header`, `siteText`, `signInText`), its loader for the root layout, the text context client components read, and the last-resort text used when the shell cannot load. `auth`, `status`, `cv` and `components/layouts` read shell text only through `index.ts` (web RULES "Layers").

## Techniques

Read types: `siteText` reads the cms-api type `siteText`; `signInText` is a GraphQL alias of the cms-api root field `moduleSignIn` (response key and web type stay `signInText` / `SignInText`).

Query file split: `SiteShell.graphql.ts` is client-safe and imports nothing from `apis/server/**`; `SiteShell.server.ts` is `server-only` and builds the query with `defineContentQuery`. `loadSiteShell` is wrapped in React `cache` and throws `WebApiError` (`NO_DATA`) when any root field failed. Texts with placeholders use `formatText` and `pickPlural` from `utils/TextTemplate.rules.ts`. The mock is `apis/server/graphql/mocks/SiteShell.mock.ts`, checked against the query selections by `SiteShell.graphql.test.ts`.

## Technologies

React (`cache`, context); `graphql` (dev, in specs).

## Entry points

`SiteTextProvider` (header, siteText, signInText), `useSiteText`, `useSignInText`, `useSiteHeader` (all `null` outside the provider), `useRequiredSiteText`, `useRequiredSignInText` (throw outside it; for the account menu and sign-in dialog), `LAST_RESORT_TEXT`, the text types (`index.ts`, client-safe); `loadSiteShell` and `SITE_SHELL_QUERY` (server file, imported by the layout and specs only).

## Where to change what

A new shared text: add it to `SITE_SHELL_ROOT_FIELDS`, the type, and `SiteShell.mock.ts` together; the spec fails when they differ. Keep the D18 limits (root fields at most 5, depth 8, field nodes 500). The context holds only text and the public header. Test provider: `ShellTextProvider` in `features/session/Session.fixture.tsx`, fed from `SiteShell.mock.ts`.
